$comment: Third-party front-end assets vendored into assets/**/vendor/ and served from 'self' so the strict script-src CSP holds. Every entry pins an exact version and the SHA-256 of the file as committed. `npm run vendor:check` re-hashes the committed files against this manifest (offline, so CI can gate on it); `npm run vendor:sync` re-fetches them from `source` when a version here changes. Bump a version by editing `version` and `source`, running vendor:sync, then pasting the printed sha256 back in.

files.name: sentry
files.note: The replay bundle, not the plain one: this site reports session replays as well as errors, so bundle.replay.min.js is the variant to keep. The CDN build rather than the npm package, because @sentry/browser ships no pre-built browser bundle. Loaded by _layouts/global.html only when site.sentry_dsn is set.
